title: Checkpoint opening
description: What a checkpoint commits to, beside the log's root, and its salt: kept in CMP-CORE-AUDIT's own checkpoint store, outside the log, and handed to the checker with the history, never published (REQ-AUD-14, REQ-AUD-10, ADR-0005). With the history's root at its size, it opens its checkpoint's commitment.

tick.description: The tick, as its checkpoint has it.

salt.description: The salt, 32 fresh bytes, base64url without padding.

size.description: The number of entries the log held, whose root the checkpoint commits to.
